patterns.description: Customers frequently report poor food quality.
Negative feedback regarding staff attitude and customer service.
Complaints about long wait times and delays.
Dissatisfaction with pricing relative to value.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report poor food quality.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent kitchen execution, poor ingredient sourcing, or lack of standardized recipes during peak hours.

root_causes.pattern: Negative feedback regarding staff attitude and customer service.
root_causes.cause: Staff burnout, understaffing, or inadequate training leading to poor guest interactions under pressure.

root_causes.pattern: Complaints about long wait times and delays.
root_causes.cause: Kitchen bottlenecks, front-of-house understaffing, and inefficient table management.

root_causes.pattern: Dissatisfaction with pricing relative to value.
root_causes.cause: Menu pricing misalignment with customer expectations regarding food quality and portion sizes.
